handlers.AddContributorRequest.description: Add a project label to a task.

difficulty.description: DEV estimation inputs, 1-5 each (0 = not assessed).

originators.description:
Originators/Requesters (user ids). Optional over the wire — defaults to the
creator when empty — so there is always at least one.

parent_task_number.description:
ParentTaskNumber, when set, creates this task as a subtask of the given
(project-local) parent task. One level only: the parent must not itself
be a subtask.

priority.description:
Priority is rejected: priorities are per-project entities now. Clients
send priority_id instead; a non-nil value here fails the whole request.

watchers.description: Watchers (user ids) who will follow the task. Optional; zero or more.

receive_enabled.description:
ReceiveEnabled gates POST /api/v1/feedback on this instance.
Defaults to false — admins (including on the main instance) must opt in
before any feedback is accepted.

send_to_main_enabled.description:
SendToMainEnabled toggles the feedback button in the sidebar for users
on *this* instance. Defaults to false so self-hosted admins must opt in.

store_sent_locally.description:
StoreSentLocally mirrors outbound submissions into this instance's own
feedback table. On by default so admins can see what their users are
saying even when the main instance is the ultimate recipient.

add_members.description:
AddMembers, when true, also adds the project's members to the destination
workspace so they keep seeing the project in that workspace's list.

subtask_total.description:
SubtaskTotal counts the subtasks matching the filter (subtasks modes
only) — the honest "+ N subtasks" next to the task total.

description.description:
Description explains when the state applies (e.g. why work sits in an
"On hold" state); shown as a tooltip wherever the state appears.

task_count.description:
TaskCount is how many (non-deleted) tasks sit in this state. Only filled
on the list endpoint, where the settings UI uses it to warn what a state
edit touches.

parent_task_id.description:
ParentTaskID/ParentTitle are set when the task is already a subtask
elsewhere; attaching it re-parents it under this task. The UI surfaces the
current parent so the move is explicit.

context_only.description:
Tree-mode list annotations: a parent kept only because a subtask matched
the filter, how many of its children the filter hides, and the matching
children embedded one level deep.

difficulty.description:
DEV estimation: Difficulty (1-5) x Effort (1-5) = ComplexityScore (1-25).
All 0 while not assessed; the score is computed on read, never stored.

originators.description:
Originators/Requesters: whose need the task represents (distinct from the
creator). At least one; defaults to the creator. Populated on the
detail/create/update responses; omitted in list responses.

priority_id.description: Priority is a per-project entity; the id plus resolved display fields.

subtask_done_count.description:
Children by state type (list responses only), for the board card's subtask
fraction. Cancelled children never count as done.

watchers.description:
Watchers follow the task to receive its updates (in-app notifications),
without being an assignee or originator. Detail-only, like originators.

is_mandatory.description:
IsMandatory marks the project's one mandatory template: the create-task
dialog opens pre-filled with it. A guide, not a lock.

state_type.description:
StateType re-categorises the state (and so every task in it) across
progress metrics, grouping and filters. Tasks reference states by id, so
no task data changes — the category of the state row does.

difficulty.description: DEV estimation inputs, 1-5 each (0 = not assessed).

figma_link.description:
Custom fields. Omitted (nil) means "leave unchanged"; send an empty
string to clear one.

priority.description:
Priority is rejected: priorities are per-project entities now. Clients
send priority_id instead; a non-nil value here fails the whole request.

is_mandatory.description: Setting true demotes any previously mandatory template of the project.

features.description:
Features lists the gated features this user can use (feature gates are
super-admin managed). Set on /me and on every auth response (signin,
signup, SSO, token refresh), so a gate change reaches live sessions on
their next refresh. The UI reads it to decide which gated surfaces to
show; the API routes enforce the gates regardless.

is_deactivated.description:
IsDeactivated is true when an admin has disabled the account. Only set on
admin listings; omitted (false = active) everywhere else. Expressed as the
negative so active accounts serialize nothing.

is_deleted.description:
Soft-delete / deactivation audit, populated only on admin listings so the
Deactivated and Deleted tabs can show when and by whom.

is_super_admin.description:
IsSuperAdmin marks the protected break-glass account so the UI can hide
its delete/demote/reset controls. Only set on admin listings; omitted
(false) everywhere else.

identity.description:
Identity is the reconciliation line: planned + added - removed = at
close = completed + in verification + open + cancelled + archived.

in_verification.description:
InVerification/Cancelled/Archived are nil when the project defines no
state of that type — the tile is absent, not zero.

original_plan_delivered.description: delivered items that were planned at start

task_list_query.description:
TaskListQuery is set only when the population is expressible as task
list filters; empty means link/CSV only. No fake equivalence.

worked_with.description:
WorkedWith lists the people who shared credit on this person's delivered
items over the window.

shared.description: of Delivered, items credited to >1 person

top_rank_handled.description: delivered at the project's top two ranks

rule.description: the attention rule, shown, not hidden

has_areas.description:
Vocabularies the frontend needs for panels that are conditional on their
existence.

has_cycles.description:
HasCycles says whether the project could run cycle reports at all; false
renders the quiet "create a cycle" hint.

counting_rule.description: CountingRule is the plain-language line shown under the scope.

to.description: inclusive end of the window's last day

projects.description:
Projects holds one row per project that contributed anything (membership
or windowed activity), most delivered first.

projects_considered.description:
ProjectsConsidered counts the viewer's projects the sums ran over, so the
scope line can be honest about coverage.
